title.tr: Tenteli ahşap pergola, taş duvarlı kavisli bank ve oval masa
title.en: Canvas-covered timber pergola with a curved stone-walled bench and an oval table

alt.tr: Gri-bej tenteli ahşap pergola, taş duvarlı kavisli bank, oval ahşap masa ve arkada çiçekli sarmaşıklar
alt.en: Timber pergola with a grey-beige canvas cover, a curved stone-walled bench, an oval wooden table and flowering climbers

caption.tr: Bankın taş tabanı çimenle çevrili. Pergolanın üstündeki tente yemek alanını güneşten koruyor.
caption.en: The stone base of the bench is ringed by lawn. The canvas over the pergola shades the dining area.
